name: Cranberry Bread
notes: May also bake as cupcakes, adjusting baking time.

items: ½ tsp ground ginger (or 2 tsp grated fresh)

steps.title: Cream the shortening and sugar
steps.body: Cream together **½ cup shortening** and **1 cup sugar**.

steps.title: Add the eggs and liquids
steps.body: Add and mix: **2 eggs**, **¾ cup orange juice** and **1 tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.body: Add and mix in: **2 cups flour**, **½ tsp baking powder**, **1 tsp nutmeg**, **1 tsp cinnamon**, **½ tsp baking soda**, **½ tsp ground ginger** (or **2 tsp grated fresh**), **½ tsp salt** and **2 tsp orange peel**.

steps.title: Stir in the add-ins
steps.body: Stir in **1½ cups coarsely chopped cranberries** and **1½ cups chopped pecans**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake in a well-oiled loaf pan. Bake at 350°F for 75 minutes, or until done.
